scope: Private context-scoped temporary Model source custody, not connected to default downloads or a public acquisition operation
evidence_policy: Completion requires fresh exact candidate-bound checks and actual separate-invocation review. This descriptive record supplies no executed or parent pass.
controls: The staging lease is reserved before current policy or filesystem work. An immutable manifest, finite payload/duration/origins and prepared canonical root/ancestor identities are captured. No root creation or shared cache mutation is authorized.

Exclusive no-follow plain single-link files receive bounded immutable chunks with exact positive short-write accounting. Currentness brackets metadata and immediately precedes each creation/write/fsync and final temporary consumer handoff.

Fsync and independently confirmed close precede closed exact-file/index/EOF/hash verification. The private root and live integrity fence are explicit parameters; global HF cache/environment and ordinary omitted-root semantics remain unchanged.

One lease spans transfer, read-only consumer use and complete positively owned cleanup. Unknown close/identity, foreign entries or unsettled transport retain bytes and custody without retry. A possibly reused descriptor is never closed a second time.
controlled_observations: Eighteen focused staging cases pass with real disposable files and controlled provider/IO faults, including a real hardlink denial and exact temporary bytes.

Tests cover limits/unprepared roots/free capacity, held consumer custody, policy withdrawal, acknowledged short writes/no progress, fsync/close failures, consumer exception, unknown extra/replaced data, renamed parents, changed bytes/index escape and unsettled transport.

Causal cancel/expiry during the final file check proves zero subsequent write/fsync. Controlled already-entered write remains owned after deadline until it actually returns, then confirmed cleanup removes only known files.
Truthy/async integrity fences deny before file open. The default root still uses the original cache resolver; a private-root verification does not call that global resolver.
retained_corrections: Independent preflight identified that filesystem metadata could block after the currentness fence, allowing a late new effect. Immediate post-metadata fences and causal zero-effect regressions correct the handoff. Earlier direct tests alone did not prove that delay.
Constructor currentness now precedes root metadata and each ancestor. Unknown close acknowledgement retains the exact file state without attempting a reused descriptor.
qualification_limits: Permitted read-only consumer use is limited to the context. Confirmed cleanup removes its files; uncertainty may retain bytes without granting persistent access, reuse or recovery. This is not a durable Model reference, registry entry, cache publication or effect approval.

Cooperative-local identity/containment checks are not a hostile native race fence, durable crash/restart accounting or hard completion-time guarantee for native filesystem operations. Unknown retained data remains untouched.

No actual external TLS/provider transfer, model weights/load/quality, real application host, public acquisition, native/offload or parent/chunk qualification is claimed. Accepted accuracy checks were not rerun.
Production task/publication/resource binding, exact approved delegate origins and physical outcomes remain I7 work. No new provider, engine, credential path, scheduler or process is added.
